findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed house flies present in the kitchen near the triple sink. There was a bin of soiled wash cloths stored on the floor which seemed to be attracting the flies. Inspector suggests sealing soiled cloths in bags each night to prevent pest development. 

Inspector also observed a small swarm of gnats/drain flies present underneath the bar near the hand sink. The floors were damp and heavily soiled, which may be contributing to pest development. See violation #55 for floor cleaning details. 

A follow-up will be conducted on September 9th, 2025 to ensure the presence of pests has reduced and professional pest control has been conducted in the facility.

findings.comment:

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C). findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)
Observed the sanitizer concentration at the bar sink to be 100 ppm. Employee stated formerly agreed upon procedure for setting up sanitizer sink. The bottle states to use 3 tablets in the sink. The addition of one tablet moved the 95 degree water to 200 ppm of available quat sanitizer. Reevaluate the current procedure and use a test strip regularly in order to verify that procedure is working as intended.

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used
findings.comment: Observed chicken thawing under running water in the 3 part sink during the afternoon break. Some of the chicken is not completely under the water. Use a larger container like a bus tub for holding the chicken during thawing. Kitchen staff will be back in less than 4 hours. Recommend that food in a process not be left unattended. 3-501.13: TCS FOOD shall be thawed: (A) at 41F or below in refrigeration (B) completely submerged under running water, not getting above 41F (water temp of 70F or below). If food will be cooked, not getting above 41F for more than 4 hours. (C) part of the cooking process (D) Using any procedure if RTE FOOD is thawed and prepared for immediate service (E) ROP FISH that bear label shall be removed from packaging before thawing under refrigeration, upon completion of thawing from running water.

Discussed routine cleaning with PIC.
